original_statement: M10-E03 reports PPJ architecture and D,d geometry in a parameter study.

original_statement: M10 uses eight repeats and labels shaded bands as 95% confidence intervals.

source_statistics: 8 repeats; CI level reported, construction not reported
calibration_validation_scope: No uncertainty budget or sensor calibration
assumptions: CI terminology follows source; method unspecified
limitations: Do not convert CI to expanded uncertainty or prediction interval

original_statement: M10 defines equivalent Young’s modulus from bending resistance of jammed granules.
assumptions: Fully jammed, tiny deformation, even granule distribution
limitations: Not intrinsic material E; no TiNi transfer

original_statement: M10 internal comparison is not independent predictive validation.

limitations: Do not call R² or curve agreement independent validation

original_statement: M12 measures pump output on a separate sealed pump because integrated pressure/flow cannot be measured.
actual_observable: Pump pressure and flow; pressure sensor at pump output
assumptions: No-flow pressure and no-load flow tests on separate setup
limitations: Do not equate 55 kPa with pressure at integrated specimen

original_statement: M12 uses negative pressure for jamming and positive pressure for bending.
actual_observable: Negative pressure, positive pressure, tip angle/displacement
assumptions: Two flow directions of ECF pump
limitations: Do not relabel ECF pump as SMA pump

original_statement: M12 reports 0.134 N to 0.743 N at 3 mm and calls the ratio 5.5 times.
actual_observable: Bending force at fixed 3 mm displacement
calibration_validation_scope: Not a tangent stiffness or modulus
assumptions: Force gauge, 0.5 mm/s, 3 mm travel, one end fixed
limitations: Do not report 5.5 as a stiffness coefficient

original_statement: M13 tests one 700-fiber nylon prototype, 0.4 mm diameter, 0–300 kPa, shaft/lateral three-point bending.
assumptions: Span 100 mm; external pressure gauge and valve
limitations: No transfer to TiNi topology

original_statement: M13 aligns curves and uses adaptive piecewise regression to extract FJ, FS, KH, KL.
actual_observable: Global F–δ and derived transition loads/slopes
assumptions: R² maximization and linear fits
limitations: Critical load is not local traction or universal contact law

original_statement: M13 identifies E=4.85 GPa and μ=0.3665 from structure-level data; E is not independently measured.
source_statistics: 95% CI reported for E, μ, regression coefficients
calibration_validation_scope: Same prototype/data family used for fit and comparison
assumptions: Model equations and three-point relation Q=F/2
limitations: Do not claim independent material/friction identification

original_statement: M13 reports model comparison and limitations, including phenomenological transition and no cross-specimen validation.
source_statistics: R² and CI for selected fits
assumptions: 0–300 kPa quasi-static range
limitations: No universal pressure–stiffness law

original_statement: M15 validates shape locking at −30 kPa and plots transverse stiffness over 0–80 kPa on OctRobot-I.
